artworks.title: Quelle est votre opinion sur ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men shown from the waist up. The man on the left is facing to his right and wears a top hat and a formal jacket. He has a prominent nose, distinct facial lines, and sideburns. The man on the right is also facing to the left but has his head tilted back, with his eyes closed and mouth open as if he is drinking from a small glass. He has thick wavy hair and is wearing a coat and a scarf around his neck. The clothing of both men looks formal and indicative of a past era. The man on the right holds a small glass in one hand while his other hand rests on a table, which also holds a bottle and another glass. The setting seems to be indoors, with another person faintly visible behind them, wearing a hat. The illustration appears to be a black and white sketch. There are etched lines on the walls.

artworks.title: Un récit de chasse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men sitting around a table. One man on the left is gesturing with his arms, pointing one finger forward and holding his other hand near his mouth. He has curly hair and exaggerated facial features. The man in the middle appears startled, with wide eyes and a wrinkled forehead. The third man has his back to the viewer with curly hair and leans slightly toward the table. They are all dressed in suits, and the table is covered with a tablecloth, holding various items. Hats hang on the wall in the background, which is plain.

artworks.title: L'ouverture de la chasse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing facing each other. The man on the left wears a tall brimmed hat and a textured coat, holding a piece of paper. The man on the right wears a cap, has distinct facial features, and appears to be carrying a rifle. The background shows text above and below the men, with faint imagery suggesting it is on a newspaper or magazine page.

artworks.title: Le retour des huitres
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men at a table in a dining setting. The man on the right faces the viewer, with distinct features such as a heavy brow and pronounced nose, and dark, wavy hair. The man on the left has light-colored, thinning hair. Both men wear dark clothing with visible collars. The scene suggests an indoor environment, likely a dining room or café. The cluttered table shows dishes, a bottle, and a knife. The background is simple with textured shading. Text is printed above and below the image.

artworks.title: Un bain contrarié
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene by a riverside with a person running out from the water. The drawing depicts a scenario with architecture in the background, a person in a small boat, and another person emerging from the water. The lines are distinct and cartoon-like, capturing a lively scene with exaggerated expressions and postures. The composition conveys a sense of movement and appears to be sketched in a humorous and satirical manner.

artworks.title: Une amelioration a apporter
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing several individuals near a turnstile. The sketch includes depictions of figures wearing period clothing, with a sign that reads "EXPOSITION" in the background.

artworks.title: Un invité à un dîner d'hippophages: Vous offrirai-je encore un peu?  C'est excellent, n'est-ce pas?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dinner scene. Three figures are seated at a table with plates, bottles, and a wine glass. A horse skull is placed on a plate as a centerpiece. The expressions of the figures vary. One appears shocked, another looks on inquiringly or animatedly, and the third scrutinizes his food closely. The illustration is detailed and monochromatic, using shading and linework to create depth and texture. It includes elements of dark humor and social commentary.

artworks.title: Musiciens jouant pendant douze heures ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a band performing at a festival. The illustration shows musicians with exaggerated and comical expressions, each wearing distinctive hats. They are playing musical instruments on a platform while entertaining a crowd below. The crowd appears lively, and the scene suggests a festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: Un ami qu'on a invité ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a small room with two people. On the left, a man lies on a bed with only his head and arm visible. His features are exaggerated and cartoonish. A man on the right, facing the bed, has exaggerated features and gestures. The room has a window with light coming in, casting shadows.

artworks.title: A la campagne, pas de grèves de cochers ... (recto); Villageois économes se contentant ... (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn cart. The cart is being pulled by a small horse and is carrying four figures. Each figure has distinct facial characteristics. The drawing emphasizes contrast between the heads and the body of the horse. The scene takes place in a minimalistic landscape with simple lines and shading in the background. The title at the top indicates a festive theme associated with a neighboring village.

artworks.title: Trois demoiselles à marier (recto); Famille bourgeoise convaincue ... (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: Three women's bodies are shown in a seated position, facing left. Their facial features are exaggerated in a caricature style. They wear bonnets with ribbons and flowers on their hair and similar voluminous dresses with fitted bodices and full skirts. The setting appears to be a grassy or rural landscape, with distant buildings visible on the horizon. The background is plain, keeping the focus on the figures.

artworks.title: Posant en membre du comice d'agriculture ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated person with one arm resting on a waist-high wall. The person has a contemplative expression, looking upwards. They are wearing a flat cap, a jacket, a light-toned shirt, and dark trousers. On the wall next to them is a decorative vase with a flowering plant, and a large watering can is at their feet. Behind them, a person stands next to a large, old-fashioned camera with a black drape over their head. The background is a plain stone or brick wall.

artworks.title: Chez un usurier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals in an office setting. The left figure appears to be offering a document to the other figure, who looks skeptical and gestures dismissively. The scene is detailed, with emphasis on the figures' expressions. The drawing shows textures and depth, with furniture like a desk and framed items in the background. The use of contrast and exaggerated features conveys emotion and narrative.

artworks.title: Toujours les Hippophages
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a social gathering featuring exaggerated, caricatured figures. The scene illustrates three prominently featured individuals in the foreground who appear to be engaging in a conversation at a formal gathering. The figures are depicted with exaggerated facial features. In the background, more figures are visible, appearing to be part of the same social event, gathered around tables with wine glasses and plates. The use of shading effectively creates a sense of depth and volume. This artwork uses a monochrome palette to portray a satirical commentary on society.

artworks.title: N'bougez pas! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing two people. On the left, a seated artist is painting or drawing. They are holding a palette and have distinctive facial features. The person on the right is standing, facing the artist. They are wearing a hat and a long dress. The background includes trees, suggesting an outdoor setting. Text at the top and bottom provides a title and a quote.

artworks.title: Vous ne prenez rien?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing depicting three individuals from the waist up. On the left, a man is leaning slightly forward and extending a small tray with a cup to the man on the right. The central figure is standing behind them wearing a tall top hat and a cloak. To the right, a third man is seated at a round table, looking intently at the man with the tray. The setting is a simple indoor environment without distinctive elements. The illustration is labeled "CROQUIS PARISIENS PAR DAUMIER" at the top.

artworks.title: Ché cha une belle chaudronnerie!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in elaborate clothing looking up at a massive sculptural object with the word "VERCINGETORIX" inscribed on it. At the top of the sculpture, there are the feet of a larger statue or figure. The individuals are making exaggerated expressions. The style is reminiscent of Daumier, known for social and political commentary through art. The use of line work and shading defines the figures and object, creating a vibrant composition.

artworks.title: Eh! Bien en regardance ce tableau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an art exhibition. Several figures are closely examining paintings or artworks on a wall. The figures are depicted in a bustling environment, showing a variety of hats and postures. One figure holds a magnifying glass up to his eye. The room is filled with framed pictures, and the overall mood is focused. The artist uses bold lines and shading. This illustration is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Vue prise a la buvette d'un bain
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in various positions. The central figure is a man bending forward in a drinking posture, holding a cup to his mouth with his right hand, while his left holds a larger cup at his side. To his left stands another man in profile, holding an object near his mouth. To the right of the central figure is a young child also in profile, holding a cup close to their mouth. In front of them, there is a person with short hair facing them. The background is a minimally detailed interior setting with a counter and various items placed on it.

artworks.title: Ouverture de la chasse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men sitting on a wooden cart. They are facing the right side of the image, with some of them raising their hats or sticks. The men have exaggerated facial features typical of cartoonish drawings and wear different styles of hats. They are dressed in simple clothing. One man at the back holds a long stick. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with another man and a dog standing on a hill. The man has raised his arms towards the sky. The scene is drawn in a monochrome style with shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Monsieur, vu l'absence complète ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men and three dogs. The man on the left is bending forward slightly, holding his hat in his left hand at waist height. He has a prominent nose, a smiling expression, and short, curly hair. He is dressed in a long coat and pants, with shoes visible at the bottom. The man on the right stands upright, smiling, raising his hat in his right hand above his head. He has a prominent chin and is wearing a long coat, trousers, and a scarf, while leaning on a walking stick held in his left hand. Surrounding them, three dogs are sniffing the ground. The background depicts a simple landscape with wavy lines suggesting hills or plains under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Un plaideur auquel manquent ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaged in a discussion. One person is dressed in legal attire, including a cap and robe, while the other is holding a paper and a hat. The background is simple, focusing on the two figures. The drawing portrays a serious yet slightly comical interaction.

artworks.title: Eh! Bien ... mon ami, a quoi penses-tu? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the center. The man on the left is leaning over with his head lowered, resting his arm on the table, and his face looking towards the viewer. He has short, dark, unkempt hair and wears a shirt with rolled-up sleeves and pants. Standing beside him, an older woman is leaning slightly forward towards the man. She has a round face with light, short hair covered by a cap and wears a long-sleeved top and a dark skirt. In her hands, she holds a candlestick with a lit candle. On the table beside the man, there is another candle and a few items. The background is shaded, indicating a dimly lit room with the candlelight suggesting a nighttime setting.

artworks.title: Séances musicales
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are four men in the image, visible from the waist up and seated closely in a row, facing to the right side of the frame. They exhibit varied expressions, distinct facial features like prominent noses and furrowed brows, and messy hair. They are dressed in generic attire. Several musical instruments including a guitar, a tambourine, and a violin float above their heads. The background is a simple, darkly shaded backdrop.
